text:
Liam (Sales): Handing off Varuna Labs (enterprise, 12mo Dedicated). Signed yesterday. Quick summary and owners below — CS please take runway.

Liam (Sales): Account snapshot: PoC success, exec sponsor committed, procurement asked for PHI controls. They expect go-live in ~30 days. Renewal upside if we avoid major infra blockers.

Liam (Sales): Needs: Okta SAML+SCIM, VPC peering + NAT/ASN info, private model mount for PHI datasets, and a capacity plan for steady 3-5 rps with 8 rps spikes.

Priya (CS): I'll own day-to-day onboarding and success checklist. Assigning owners: Priya (onboarding lead), Maya (enablement + docs), Sam (support runbook + pager), Aisha (infra/peering), Devin (smoke tests & prompts).

Priya (CS): Pre-kickoff asks from CS: customer SSO metadata, public ASN, expected daily request curve, and any compliance artifacts (DPA/BAA already signed?).

Liam (Sales): Procurement confirmed DPA signed. Contact is devops@varunalabs.com (Asha). ASN is pending - I'll get it by EOD.

Aisha (Eng): Infra note: For private mounts + Dedicated, we need subnet ranges and peering CIDRs. We'll provision a dedicated GPU pool with quantization profile to save cost. Prewarm plan: run KV warmup + 10 synthetic sessions during business hours to populate caches.

Devin (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a 10-prompt smoke CSV (short/long/few-shot) and a small python test harness for latency + quality checks. Will upload to /shared/varuna-tests.

Devin (Solutions Eng): Quick curl example for their infra team to validate post-SSO:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://dedicated.us.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-ded","input":"Summarize: The quick brown fox"}'
```

Maya (CS PM): Enablement plan: 45m session + 15m Q&A. Ill include a short recording, a walkthrough doc, and a 1-pager with cutover criteria and rollback steps. Draft by tomorrow noon.

Sam (Support): I'll create the VAR-202 ticket for onboarding tasks and list out alert thresholds, oncall rotation, and escalation path. Need to know preferred peering windows.

Liam (Sales): Varuna prefers peering 0300-0500 UTC on weekdays. Also asked for a provisional credit clause: 10% of monthly fee if p95 > 300ms for 60 days after go-live. Legal ok'd a conditional clause. Flag for CS risk register.

Priya (CS): Adding to risk register: PHI mount + HSM timeline. If HSM not available within 6 weeks, procurement may request add'l controls or delay renewal. Aisha, can you confirm HSM availability for Dedicated tenants?

Aisha (Eng): HSM for Dedicated tenants is on the roadmap: ETA 5-7 weeks. KMS with customer-managed keys is available now for staging; we can provide a compliance note for procurement. Will coordinate with security.

ops-bot: Ticket VAR-202 created by Sam (Support) - https://support.redwood.ai/VAR-202

Sam (Support): Putting initial checklist in ticket: SSO verify, SCIM provisioning test, peering verify, model mount verify, smoke test pass, canary traffic 10%, full cutover. Will link runbook and oncall calendar.

Priya (CS): Action items (owners):
- Priya: schedule kickoff + weekly checkpoints, risk register owner
- Aisha: validate VPC peering config + confirm HSM/KMS note (owner)
- Devin: upload smoke tests + test harness (owner)
- Sam: populate VAR-202 with alerting/playbook and rotation (owner)
- Maya: enablement deck + recording + 1-pager (owner)

Devin (Solutions Eng): Okta SAML details to share with customer:
- ACS URL: https://auth.redwood.ai/saml/varuna/acs
- Entity ID: https://auth.redwood.ai/saml/varuna
- SCIM endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/scim/Users

Liam (Sales): Noted: customer asked for KV cache behavior docs and tokenization/cost estimate for 512 vs 2048 token windows. Can someone supply a short cost/latency matrix?

Aisha (Eng): I'll attach a short matrix to VAR-202 after the staging capacity run. Preliminary: 512 tokens p95 ~210-260ms on a40 class with batching; 2048 jumps ~2x latency depending on model. We'll run targeted tests tomorrow.

Maya (CS PM): Success criteria were tracking: go-live within 30d, p95 < 300ms at steady load, smoke test pass, SSO + SCIM working, zero critical incidents first 14 days.

Priya (CS): Will compile those into the kickoff agenda. Please add any pre-kickoff docs to /shared/varuna by Wed EOD.

Sam (Support): Oncall note: I'll set high-priority alert for error-rate >2% and latency >400ms p95 for first 2 weeks and auto-page.

Liam (Sales): Thanks everyone. I'll loop in Varuna AM after kickoff.

Aisha (Eng): Follow-up: posted staging run results to VAR-202 - baseline p95 235ms @512 tokens, 5 qps sustained. Graphs in ticket.

Priya (CS): Great. I'll update the risk register and send calendar invites for kickoff (Thu 15:00 UTC). Owners, please update VAR-202 as items progress.

Maya (CS PM): I'll record the enablement session and upload slides to the shared folder.

Devin (Solutions Eng): Uploaded smoke CSV + python harness to /shared/varuna-tests. Add creds once peering and SSO are done.

Sam (Support): VAR-202 checklist updated. Linking runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/varuna-onboarding-runbook. Please review.

Priya (CS): Closing: keep daily updates in VAR-202 until go-live. Good handoff team.
